decisions.reason: screening batch a7-auth-rotation, b2-patch-endpoint, b3-pagination, d4-cache-fencing, p1-ticket-batch, p2-handler-migration

hypothesis.text: Requiring implementation workers to derive and run contract checks before editing code should reduce circular verification by anchoring expected behavior to the original requirements rather than implementation assumptions.
hypothesis.expectedEffect: More specified boundary and failure cases are exercised before implementation, and completed changes satisfy more of the original requirements even when the existing suite already passes.
